name: Stealth Browser MCP
why: Deep web-app inspection, screenshots, DOM, network, cookies, storage.
install: Clean profile, site allowlist, visible approvals.

name: GitHub MCP
why: Repos, issues, PRs, review threads, CI output.
risk: Platform token scope and write authority.
install: Read-only token first; require approval for writes.

name: Gmail MCP
risk: Private mailbox context and send/delete actions.
install: Scoped OAuth, no automatic sends or destructive actions.

name: Filesystem MCP
why: Agent-readable project files and controlled file writes.

name: Playwright MCP
why: Open pages, click, type, screenshot, inspect browser state.
risk: Browser session reuse and credentialed page actions.
install: Clean profile, scoped sites, no silent credential entry.

name: Fetch MCP
why: Pull docs, API responses, and remote text into context.
risk: Remote content and outbound data flow.

name: Postgres MCP
why: Query application data and development databases.
install: Read-only users, local replicas, query limits.

name: Memory + Shell MCP
why: Persist notes and run local helper commands.
risk: Terminal injection and sensitive persisted context.
